title: Filtering the categories table by numbers

steps.title: Keep id > 1
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where id is bigger than 1.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM categories.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is id > 1.
Write: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows id > 1
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM categories.
Add WHERE id > 1.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM categories WHERE id > 1;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'
